description: Performs an offline syntactic check of a VAT number against the country-specific regex pattern. Read-only and offline: no network call, no API key, no rate limit, no side effects. Does NOT verify the VAT with VIES (a valid format does not mean the VAT is real or active) — use validate_vat_number for that. Output: { input, normalized, countryCode, validFormat (boolean), error }; countryCode is null when the prefix is unknown. Use when the user wants a quick sanity check on the shape of a VAT ID without burning a quota call. Free, no API key required.

vatId.description: A VAT number, with or without spaces/dashes, with or without country prefix (e.g. "DE123456789", "IE 6388047 V").

name: check_vat_format
title: Check VAT number format
